title: Terry Lovelace's 'Dr Bug' abduction told at 2018 conference
place_text: Whiteman Air Force Base area; conference venue

tellings.quote: when he told the story about being on a table and Dr bug comes over and start and he's screaming as loud as he can and Dr bug looks over at him and says stop screaming

plain: A man named Terry Lovelace says he was taken by aliens near Whiteman Air Force Base in Missouri and laid on a table, screaming as loud as he could, until a being he called Dr. Bug came over, looked at him, and told him to stop screaming. John Blitch, a scientist with DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, heard Lovelace tell this at a conference in 2018. Blitch repeats it as he heard it, and it struck him because of his own reported abduction.
